Our Team

Joshua Farahzad

Project Lead

Josh is a sophomore at Duke University studying electrical engineering and economics. He's operated a business, a nonprofit and has volunteered at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory. Josh's long term interests lie in human biology and space. He's excited to work with motivated students who share his passions for space. He can be reached at joshfarahzad@gmail.com.

Saad Mirza

Design Lead

Saad is skilled in systems-level design and optimization of unguided suborbital rocket systems, having previously served as the project manager of Princeton University's SpaceShot team. Saad has also worked at the Georgia Tech Aerospace Systems Design Laboratory. He hopes to lead the team to success, and in the long term, usher in a new era of supersonic commercial air travel. Saad can be reached at smirza@princeton.edu.
